blocks.text: THIS WILL BE A SCROLL OF SCRIPTURES— Prophetic Mysteries and revelations — ‘‘The Lord Himself tells us the end in the very beginning!’’ — He worked 6 days and rested on the 7th day. (Gen. 2:2) — One day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day. (II Peter 3:8) — Also Read Gen. 2:4 on generations. - And the 6 thousand years is up! We are in a transition period now! — The last generation is ending!

JESUS PROPHECIES— He said, ‘‘When ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.”’ And your redemption draweth nigh. (Luke 21:20,28) — And they are surrounded by Arab armies and etc., and they are fully armed! — And He tells us when, the last generation. Jesus said, ‘‘Verily I say unto you, this generation shall not pass till all these things be fulfilled!’’ (Matt. 24:34) — And this was especially associated to the budding of the Fig Tree, wherein it meant that Israel would blossom again as a nation!’’ — This great sign occurred May 14, 1948, and the ‘‘Fig Tree’’ was taken as their national symbol, just as was prophesied. — Jesus said, ‘‘This generation shall not pass away until all be fulfilled! So the elect should Prepare now for the soon return of Jesus!’’

MIDNIGHT CRY IN THE THUNDERS— St. Matt. 25:6-10, And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him. Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps. And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out. But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves. And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut. — The finality of the parable depicts in one way it was at midnight (late hours of the century) — My opinion is at some point in this decade! — “We are living in this crying time; forceful urgency!’’ A last warning period: — when the wise said, go to them that sell. ‘‘Of course when they got there the midnight criers were gone, (translated) with Jesus! ‘‘And the door was shut. (Vr. 10) — Symbolically in the heavens this would depict the 12th constellation sign (lion) — the harvest sign in Mazzaroth. (Job 38:32) — The rest went through great tribulation! (Rev. 7:13-14)

THE MYSTERY OF THE DOOR— Rev. 4:1-3, After this Ilooked, and behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter. And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne. And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald — Here in this pictorial John is portraying the Translation!”’ The door is open, the bride is in around the throne! One sat on the throne and He had one group (the elect) with Him! — ‘‘The rainbow reveals redemption, and that His promise was true!’’ — Rev. 8:1, evidently reveals the same thing, or translation is over! — John heard a trumpet. — Vr. 7 reveals another trumpet and the Tribulation begins with fire out of heaven! — ‘‘And as we go through the rest of the chapters the judgments worsened!’’— Remember the parable of the virgins? The door was shut. — So by hindsight we see what really occurred by reading this in Rev., chap 4. TIME IS SHORT — ‘‘This prophecy is previewing itself, part already before it begins!’’ Rev. 6:1-8, And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts sayings, Come and see. And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer. And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see. And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword. And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand. And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine. And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see. And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth. — Remember at Babylon the races were scattered over the earth. But the colors of these horses shows the anti-Christ will mix the races again under one united Babylon worldwide! (Rev. Chap. 17) — ‘‘This is in progress now. Within this decade the pale horse of death will shew forth the mistake and fatalism of this world system! — Dan. 2:43, spoke of this. — This all started with the mark of Cain, and it will now finish its course in the mark of the beast. The races have been duped by a false god for rejecting a true Lord Jesus! — ‘‘The last century of these six thousand years will culminate I believe in fulfilling all the prophecies concerning end of age!’’
THE FOUNDATION OF THE EARTH AND SEA ALREADY SHAKING!— Scripts prophecies coming true! — ‘‘Vast field of volcanoes on sea floor found.’’ — We quote from News article: BUENOS AIRES,

Argentina — Scientists mapping the sea floor 600 miles northwest of Easter Island in the South Pacific have found what they say is the greatest concentration of active volcanoes on Earth. Using sonar scanning devices to peer into the ocean depths, the scientists aboard the research vessel Melville were surprised to discover 1,133 seamounts and volcanic cones in an area about the size of New York state. Many of the volcanoes rise more than a mile above the ocean floor, and some are almost 7,000 feet tall, with their peaks 2,500 to 5,000 feet below the sea’s surface. Two or three of the volcanoes may be erupting at any given moment. There is no greater concentration of volcanoes inland, either, specialists said.

Indeed, the finding underscores just how little is known about the ocean depths. Many scientists say that more is known about the mountains and valleys on the dark side of the moon than about the ocean floor. One estimated that no more than 5 percent of the sea bottom has been mapped in detail. One potential benefit of the discovery, scientists said, is that the volcanic eruptions are generating large new mineral deposits,

including copper, iron, sulfur and gold. The discovery also is likely to intensify speculation over whether volcanic activity, pouring huge amounts of heat into the ocean, could change water temperatures enough to affect weather patterns in the Pacific. — Note: Ps. 82:5, ‘‘They know not, neither will they understand, they walk onto darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.’’ — The continental plates are opening up with fire! — ‘‘All over the world the Lord is preparing for what He prophesied!’’ — Rom. 8:22, All of nature is travailing. (Strong

winds, storms, famines and quakes and etc.) Because the sons of God are coming forth. (Vr. 19) — ‘‘Due to atomic weapons, gas, oil, stones of fire, asteroids from space; great parts of the seas of the world will look like liquid fire!’’ — (I saw fire in the sea out by California.) — ‘‘The safe haven is in Jesus arms now!’’ - In our generation it won’t be long until parts of California falls into the sea!

CONTINUING— Earth Rushing to Judgment — Space Video shows quake moving ground. — (Quote AP) — The National Aeronautics and Space Administration used satellite photos to make a video showing how the ground moved along fault lines in California’s Mojave Desert during the June 28, 1992 — 7.5-magnitude Landers earthquake. It was California’s strongest quake in 40 years and third strongest this century. This video, similar to the cloud-motion displays on television weather reports, provides abird’s-eye view of movement along several faults in the sparsely populated area roughly 100 miles east-northeast of Los Angeles. Among the details the quake video shows are blocks of ground as big as football fields rotating clockwise, and places where roads can be seen bending as they cross faults. It’s the first time fault motion has been observed by using images from space, said a geologist at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena, California. He showed the video at the American Geophysical Union’s meeting. The five-day convention, drew about 6,000 scientists studying the Earth, space, the atmosphere and the oceans.
Note: ‘‘In the short years ahead, people will begin to feel the axis shaking!

“Then before or by ending of century a worldwide axis jolt will take place leveling mountains, cities and etc. — ‘‘In the midst of apostasy God is preparing this planet; and the elect are entering an outpouring ofthe spirit!’” He will doa quick short work in righteousness. — ‘‘Ina moment, ina twinkling of an eye the real believers will be gone!”’

MYSTERY AND REVELATION— ‘‘We are entering the stage of 3fold manifestation.’’ In the early 1900’s there was a Pentecostal outpouring! — Then we had a great former rain from 1946 onward! — ‘‘And now the former and latter rain will come together, and surely will increase in power as we enter the 90’s for a climatic restoration!’’ — This will lead to the dramatic scenes shown in Rev. 10:1-7. — Wherein the 7 Thunders uttered their voices! Their secrets revealed to the elect only and the full power of the Lord will bring forth the resurrection and translation of His saints! — What a time of refreshing is moving in on us! — The last chapter of Revelation, the words of Jesus was, ‘‘Behold, I come quickly!’? — We are to be expectant of these things daily. The Lord is definitely standing at the door because the end of all things is at hand! (I Peter 4:7)
